guestAssetPolicy: Fetched only on Boot. Original firmware/kernel/disk files use an immutable CORS mirror hash-matched to the author release; Alpine and Debian archives use their official immutable GitHub artifact commits and published digests. No guest binaries are included in the repository or build.

externalGuestAssets.role: 4 MiB writable ext2 root disk with BusyBox 1.21.1
externalGuestAssets.sourceBundleStatus: Exact root image build recipe and complete corresponding source bundle not established; not redistributed by Terrarium.

externalGuestAssets.sourceAvailability: The installed APK database records package versions, licenses, source package names, and exact Alpine aports commits. Upstream APKBUILD recipes identify source archives and patches.

externalGuestAssets.role: Debian GNU/Linux 13.7 slim RISC-V64 root filesystem archive
externalGuestAssets.license: Per-package copyright and license files are retained under /usr/share/doc/*/copyright; this is a collection, not one license.
externalGuestAssets.sourceAvailability: The pinned artifact repository contains package versions, Debian release metadata, debuerreotype metadata, and snapshot.debian.org source/archive references for the image build date.

runtimeConfiguration.pause: Dedicated-worker timer suspension, verified with live guest output
runtimeConfiguration.network: VirtIO Ethernet frames supplied to the page-scoped NetworkPort; no hardcoded relay
rootFilesystems: Alpine and Debian gzip tar roots assembled into memory-backed VirtIO 9p by filesystem.js

guestLimitations: Every RISC-V64 profile still uses the historical Linux 4.15 kernel; newer userspace versions do not imply a newer kernel.
Only the original BusyBox 1.21.1 profile lacks glibc NSS DNS libraries. Alpine and Debian native DNS and HTTP are verified on a nondefault VPC subnet.
The webget helper uses the selected subnet gateway and requires World mode with Browser bridge; no global proxy environment is installed.
RISC-V64 profiles expose one console, no VM checkpoints, and no Kubernetes/container stack. RISC-V64 is not x86-64.
Package manager version execution is verified. Arbitrary package installations and guest TLS relay integration are not verified.
